title: CSI Division 03 Concrete
content: Concrete placement, curing, and formwork sequencing for commercial work. Verify mix design, cold-weather protections, and strength tests before stripping forms.

title: CSI Division 09 Finishes
content: Drywall, flooring, and paint coordination with punch and closeout. Protect finished work during remaining trades.

title: AIA A201 General Conditions
content: Contractual roles for owner, architect, and contractor. Change orders require written authorization and time/price impact documentation.

title: OSHA Fall Protection
content: Fall protection triggers and competent person duties on elevated work. Inspect harnesses and anchor points daily.

title: Bid Leveling Checklist
content: Normalize alternates, allowances, unit prices, exclusions, and schedule assumptions before award recommendation.

title: RFI Best Practices
content: Write RFIs with drawing references, conflict description, schedule impact, and a proposed solution for faster architect response.

title: Pay Application SOV
content: Align schedule of values to cost codes for AIA-style G702/G703 billing. Retainage and stored materials must match contract terms.

title: CTE Electrical Fundamentals
content: Ohm's law, conduit fill awareness, and lockout/tagout fundamentals for CTE electrical pathways.

title: Job Cost Variance
content: Compare committed cost, actual cost, and forecast to complete weekly. Flag overruns before pay apps are certified.

title: Warranty Closeout Package
content: Collect O&M manuals, attic stock, training attendance, and warranty start dates before substantial completion.
